items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies Cech cohomology with the right derived functors of Cech H-0 on the category of abelian presheaves and produces a functorial quasi-isomorphism between the Cech complex and the derived functor (statement lines 1188-1217). The proof is complete and has three parts: it first verifies that Cech cohomology of an injective presheaf vanishes in positive degrees through the exactness of the representable complex and of hom into an injective, which makes the Cech delta-functor effaceable and hence universal (proof lines 1228-1248); it then identifies it with the universal delta-functor of the right derived functors (proof lines 1250-1258); and finally it resolves the presheaf injectively and compares the two maps into the total complex of the resulting double complex, whose rows and columns are exact in positive degrees, obtaining the quasi-isomorphism of the statement (proof lines 1262-1301). The author marks the middle of the proof as skippable and omits only the functoriality verification at the end; both are retained verbatim inside the counted span.
